definitions.gloss: respectfully yours; sincerely (closing of a formal letter)
definitions.explanation: A very formal closing phrase used in traditional Japanese letter writing, originally meaning 'bowing one's head to the ground.' Paired with {拝啓|はいけい} (Dear Sir/Madam) as the opening.

definitions.gloss: a deep bow of respect; kowtow
definitions.explanation: The original meaning: to quickly touch one's forehead to the ground as a gesture of respect. Now rarely used in this literal sense.

examples.japanese: ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧　{時下|じか}⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧ご{清栄|せいえい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こととお{慶|よろこ}び⟦{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます→申し上げる：01734_moushiageru⟧。...{頓首|とんしゅ}
examples.english: Dear Sir/Madam, I hope you are well and prospering. ... Respectfully yours

examples.japanese: ⟦{手紙|てがみ}→手紙：00675_tegami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末尾|まつび}→末尾：13065_matsubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{頓首|とんしゅ}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{改|あらた}まった⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧だ。
examples.english: Writing 'tonshu' at the end of a letter is an extremely formal expression.

examples.japanese: {頓首|とんしゅ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{地面|じめん}→地面：00125_jimen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{額|ひたい}→額：03579_hitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦{礼|れい}→礼：02170_rei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{動作|どうさ}→動作：04074_dousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Tonshu refers to the act of touching one's forehead to the ground as a bow of respect.

notes:
Originally a Chinese custom of prostrating oneself with the forehead touching the ground. In modern Japanese, used almost exclusively as a formal letter-closing formula.

LETTER FORMAT:
In traditional Japanese letter writing, openings and closings come in matched pairs:
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧...⟦{敬具|けいぐ}→敬具：12977_keigu⟧: standard formal pair
- ⟦{拝啓|はいけい}→拝啓：12790_haikei⟧...{頓首|とんしゅ}: more elevated formal pair
- ⟦{謹啓|きんけい}→謹啓：22309_kinkei⟧...{謹言|きんげん}/{頓首|とんしゅ}: most formal pair

USAGE:
{頓首|とんしゅ} is traditionally used by men; women conventionally use かしこ instead. This gender distinction is becoming less strict in modern usage but still observed in very formal correspondence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{敬具|けいぐ}→敬具：12977_keigu⟧: sincerely; respectfully — the standard formal letter closing, less elevated than {頓首|とんしゅ}
- かしこ: respectfully (women's letter closing) — the traditional female equivalent
- {草々|そうそう}: in haste — a less formal closing, paired with {前略|ぜんりゃく}
